source_title: Lucid Diagnostics Begins Receiving Medicare Reimbursement for EsoGuard® and Closes $15 Million Financing - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
Lucid is now submitting Medicare claims and receiving payments at EsoGuard's established Clinical Laboratory Fee Schedule rate
Series C Preferred Stock private placement with existing long-term shareholders strengthens Lucid's balance sheet, extends its cash runway, and supports near-term commercial acceleration
NEW YORK , Oct. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Lucid Diagnostics Inc. (Nasdaq: LUCD ) ("Lucid" or the "Company"), a commercial-stage, cancer prevention medical diagnostics company and subsidiary of PAVmed Inc. (Nasdaq: PAVM ), today announced that it has begun receiving payments from Medicare for its EsoGuard ® Esophageal DNA Test . The Company also closed a $15.0 million private placement on October 21, 2026, for shares of its newly designated Series C Convertible Preferred Stock (the "Series C Preferred Stock") to existing long-term shareholders.
"Medicare is now paying for EsoGuard," said Lishan Aklog, M.D. , Lucid's Chairman and Chief Executive Officer. "For the first time, Medicare beneficiaries nationwide have fully reimbursed access to the groundbreaking EsoGuard test. This breakthrough marks a seminal moment in our mission to end the scourge of esophageal cancer through precancer testing of at-risk patients. It opens up significant near-term commercial opportunities that extend beyond primary care, gastroenterology, and geriatric practices. Medicare reimbursement removes a key headwind in our continued engagement with large health systems and will also help accelerate our efforts to secure coverage by commercial payors. Our team is laser-focused on translating this pivotal milestone into near-term commercial results, and this financing provides the resources we need to do so."
On September 22, Lucid announced that it would begin submitting Medicare claims for EsoGuard tests performed at one of its two CLIA-certified laboratories. Shortly thereafter, the Company began receiving payments on those claims at the established EsoGuard (PLA code 0114U) Clinical Laboratory Fee Schedule rate of $1,938.01 per test.
The Series C Preferred Stock was sold at a purchase price of $1,000 per share and is convertible into common stock at a conversion price of $0.3519 per share. Investors in the private placement included holders of a majority of the Company's 12.0% senior secured convertible notes due 2029 (the "Notes"). The Series C Preferred Stock includes customary terms, including certain mandatory conversion events, a dividend and liquidation preference, and an agreement by the Company to file a resale registration statement covering the underlying shares of common stock within 120 days following closing. Participating holders of the Notes also acknowledged that the Company's receipt of payments on submitted Medicare claims as described above has addressed the concerns underlying the Notes' Medicare-related event of default provision. Lucid intends to use the net proceeds to accelerate its near-term commercial operations and for working capital and general corporate purposes.
Additional details of the Series C Preferred private placement can be found in the Company's Current Report on Form 8-K filed concurrently with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
About Lucid Diagnostics Lucid Diagnostics Inc. is a commercial-stage, cancer prevention medical diagnostics company, and subsidiary of PAVmed Inc. (Nasdaq: PAVM ). Lucid is focused on the millions of patients with gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), also known as chronic heartburn, who are at risk of developing esophageal precancer and cancer. Lucid's EsoGuard ® Esophageal DNA Test , performed on samples collected in a brief, noninvasive office procedure with its EsoCheck ® Esophageal Cell Collection Device , represent the first and only commercially available tools designed with the goal of preventing cancer and cancer deaths through widespread, early detection of esophageal precancer in at-risk patients.
For more information, please visit www.luciddx.com and for more information about its parent company PAVmed, please visit www.pavmed.com .
